market_view: Pre-market 6:40 ET Monday of Thanksgiving week: a relief rally after the Nasdaq 100's worst week since March 2020. S&P futures +2.6%, Nasdaq 100 +3%: SPY 710.08 (Friday 689.81), QQQ 631.41 (608.45), IWM 263.03, NVDA 136.20 (+8.5% after -14% Friday on a reported regulators' accounting review; Trump renewed a call to bring back Jensen Huang), TSM +7.2%, SMH +6.1%, CRWV +8.1%. VIX 30 at Friday's close, 10-year 4.91%, WTI US$82.09, gold US$3,621, BTC US$61,384 with Fear & Greed 11. Last week's bonus went to Fox (+C$4,997). The desk wants proof the bounce holds past 10:30 before adding risk.

shared_notes: Thanksgiving week: Thursday closed, Friday 1:00 PM ET close. Nobody chases the political NVDA gap.
Option orders go live at 9:45 ET; Vega and Theo meet at 9:31 first.

day.view: Dax: Friday's one trade, CRVO, stopped out for -C$93. Today is the opposite tape: a gap up. Squeeze ORB names gap with the market, so I want 5x volume and a hold above VWAP after 9:45, four trades max. My new lesson: bank the 1R half fast, because VIX is still near 30.

playbook.if: the gap holds at 9:45 with QQQ over 625
playbook.then: run the squeeze list, four trades max
sell half and move the stop to breakeven at once

plan_c.note: Down 4% on the day: stand aside

day.failsafe: Down 4% on the day or VIX over 32: stand aside.
lessons_applied: VIX near 30: take the 1R half and go to breakeven immediately.
Squeeze ORB only; plain ORB+VWAP skipped.

swing.view: Sam: NVDA hit its stop Friday, and I hold CRWV, COIN and RKT with C$1,556 cash. The review cut my frequency, and my new lesson says no new play while the S&P is under its 20-day. A one-day bounce doesn't change that, so no buys today; the stops work.

playbook.if: the S&P closes back above its 20-day average
playbook.then: the scan gets a look tomorrow
hold; the stop rises with the engine's trail

plan_b.note: COIN stopped: cash waits for the scan

plan_c.note: Fear is up: no new buys

swing.failsafe: VIX over 26 or a 5% day loss: no new buys, stops stay.
lessons_applied: No new play in a falling market (S&P under its 20-day).
A dip buy outside the scan needs a planned sale: none today.

long.view: Lena: Monday is my buying day. After last week's drop, every stop is still intact. One SHEL share (US$93.58 at Friday's close; energy, outside the AI trade) only if the rally holds: limit US$95, stop US$77 (about 18% under), cut-off 11:00. If it doesn't fill, I skip the week.

playbook.then: the limit fills; stop about 18% under

playbook.if: the bounce fails and VIX goes over 32

orders.why: Weekly long-term buy: one SHEL share (energy, outside the AI trade) at US$95 or better; stop US$77, about 18% under.

plan_b.note: SHEL never filled: the week's buy is skipped

plan_c.note: Fear spike: no buys this week

long.failsafe: VIX over 28: no buys this week.
lessons_applied: Paper drawdown with every stop intact: no sales.

futures.view: Fox: I won the week and the C$200 bonus, mostly on the gold short. Gold is US$3,621, and my trailing stop protects most of it. The review cut my aggression to 8, and my lesson says no adds. Crude US$82.09 is near its 20-day low with the short open. No new trade.

playbook.if: gold rallies through the trailing stop
playbook.then: the short closes with most of the gain; no re-short

plan_b.note: Gold short stopped: no revenge trade

plan_c.note: Down 4%: no new futures; stops stay

futures.failsafe: Down 4% on the day: no new futures; stops stay.
lessons_applied: After a big open win: the trailing stop protects it, no adds.
After a big win, risk small: no third position.

options_aggr.view: Vega: The relief rally is a gap, and my rule is to buy only a gap that extends. If QQQ trades above 640 after 9:45 (over today's pre-market high area), 2 calls about 3% out. With VIX near 30 the premiums are fat, so a fade means no trade.

plan_b.note: The relief rally extends: the one trade today

orders.why: QQQ extending above 640 on the relief rally: 2 calls about 3% out; -50% stop, +100% target

plan_c.note: No extension by 2:00: no option today

options_aggr.failsafe: Down 12% on the day or VIX over 30: no new options.
lessons_applied: Didn't chase yesterday's gap; same discipline today: only a reclaim gets the trade.
Two contracts so a risk-off cut doesn't round to zero.

options_safe.view: Theo: RKT US$14.05, above my 12.50 strike with 18 days left. One put at a time: no new put. The cash stays parked.

options_safe.failsafe: VIX over 27: keep the cash, no new puts.

crypto.view: Kai: The 7-day gap allowed one extreme-fear add, and it went in at 7:45 (ETH, 5%). BTC is US$61,384 and Fear & Greed 11, so crash mode holds: no more buys. Stops are now one step wider after the review.

playbook.if: BTC reclaims US$68,000 and holds a day
playbook.then: still no buy, a bounce isn't a signal

playbook.if: Fear & Greed rises above 25 with BTC over US$65,000

plan_b.note: A bounce is not a buy signal: hold and keep the cash

plan_c.note: Deeper flush: still no buys; stops handle exits

crypto.failsafe: Down 8% on the day: no buys; stops stay.
lessons_applied: The 7-day gap is a ceiling, not a target: one add today, no more.
Wider stops (stop_width 7) after five stops in two days.
